title: Game Big-Data Analytics Shushu Tech Raises ¥100M Series C+ from GGV
summary: On Aug 22, 2022, game big-data analytics vendor Shushu Tech (数数科技) closed a ¥100M Series C+ from GGV Capital — third raise in two years; cumulative ~¥600M across 6 rounds. Founded Jun 2015; Thinking Analytics (TA) platform — event/retention/funnel/path/SQL/cohort… 10 models;
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · August 23, 2022

On Aug 22, 2022, game big-data analytics vendor Shushu Tech (数数科技) closed a ¥100M Series C+ from GGV Capital — third raise in two years; cumulative ~¥600M across 6 rounds. Founded Jun 2015; Thinking Analytics (TA) platform — event/retention/funnel/path/SQL/cohort… 10 models; public cloud + single-node/cluster private deploy. 700+ game studios; 4,000+ titles incl. Jiangnan Baiching, Mole’s World, Shine Nikki, Strongest Snail, Snake.io… Clients: CMGE, Papergames, Dots, Boke, Hero, Habby. Use: channel ROI, ice-breaker pay, churn-path localization. Next: go-global product polish.

— END —
